owner: the CU-BUDGET lane. ONE file, ONE owner. A tier does not carry its own copy of a number that lives here; it carries a `cu-budget` witness naming its campaign, and the shared evaluator tools/gauntlet/tier1/check-witnesses.sh reads this file.
note: Checked-in per-transaction compute budgets for the golden transactions. A budget is a CEILING a campaign must stay under, evaluated against that campaign's own finalized evidence. Over budget is a red row naming the transaction and the delta. Read CU_BUDGETS.md before changing a number in here; in particular, read what it says about noise, because the numbers in this file are NOT deterministic and the tolerances are the whole reason the file is usable.

ceiling.provenance: Solana's per-transaction MAX_COMPUTE_UNIT_LIMIT. It is the chain's limit, not ours: a transaction that asks for more is refused at request time, and one that consumes it is refused at the ceiling with no partial result. Found31 died exactly this way before c61376d. Every `transaction`-scope budget in this file must be at or below it; a budget above the ceiling is refused by the evaluator, which is how this file says out loud that a transaction has stopped fitting.

tolerance_rule.formula: tolerance = roundup(observed_band, 10000) + 10000, with a floor of 15000; budget = measured + tolerance
tolerance_rule.measured_at: the `measured` value of every entry is the HIGHEST draw this lane observed, not a single run. Pinning the highest draw is what keeps ordinary noise from producing a red row.
tolerance_rule.noise: The CU figures on both campaigns move run to run on byte-identical artifacts, and the cause is exact: every campaign here generates fresh signing keypairs per run (`Keypair::new()` in the successor bootstrap; ProgramTest's own genesis payer in the fast lane), which changes how many iterations `find_program_address` needs to find a bump, and each iteration is one `sol_create_program_address` syscall at 1,500 CU. EVERY delta this lane measured between runs is an exact multiple of 1,500 (a handful of +-4 residuals aside), which is what makes the diagnosis a measurement rather than a story.
tolerance_rule.measured_bands: tier 1, two campaigns 23 minutes apart whose seven ELFs are byte-identical except Trading's line-number metadata (d9f79bb at 08:27Z, 3b0c588 at 08:50Z, both 2026-08-27): DCLTGMF1 moved 58,494 CU; DCLTPCB1 moved 51,005; the reordered-tail refusal moved 55,503; per-role activation moved 1,500-9,000; Found31, the Found31 rollback case, the infrastructure profile init and the non-terminal DCLTPCB1 refusal moved by ZERO. A stronger figure needs no second run at all: the d9f79bb campaign stages TWO structurally identical DCLTPCB1 ladders at different generations, and they differ by 79,500 CU (exactly 53 iterations) inside ONE campaign on ONE binary. tier 4, six runs of the same ProgramTest campaign on the same ELFs: the founding case spans 24,000, the replay campaign 19,500, the late-Hoard refusal 15,000, the replayed-ticket refusal 4,500, the substituted-ProgramData refusal 1,500.
tolerance_rule.what_this_buys_and_what_it_does_not: A tolerance that exceeds the band cannot also catch a regression smaller than the band. On tier 1's founding transactions the band is 58,494-79,500, so a +30,000 regression to DCLTGMF1 is NOT reliably caught by its whole-transaction budget and this file will not pretend otherwise. What IS caught: any structural regression larger than the tolerance, on any draw; and — the thing W1f actually asked for — the moment the transaction gets close enough to the 1,400,000 ceiling that the budget can no longer be written down. The teeth at the 30,000 scale live on the entries whose measured band is zero or near it (Found31, the Found31 rollback case, the infrastructure profile init, the DCLTPCB1 non-terminal refusal) and on the tier-4 fast lane, which is also the one that runs pre-campaign.
tolerance_rule.how_to_shrink_it: Seed the fixtures. If the successor bootstrap derived its keypairs from a fixed seed (a `--keypair-seed` on `dclutch-local-successor-bootstrap run`) the band would collapse to zero and every tolerance here could drop to 15,000, which WOULD catch a 30,000 regression on DCLTGMF1. That file is tools/local-validator/bootstrap/successor/ and belongs to W1f; this lane is read-only toward it. Queued as an owner-decision in CU_BUDGETS.md. The same is true of ProgramTest's genesis payer for the tier-4 fast lane, in programs/dclutch-core-sbf/tests/found_program_test.rs.

budgets.transaction: found the Market atomically: Lock, Found, Realize, Claims, Open (DCLTGMF1)
budgets.provenance: THE transaction this lane exists for. Five stages in one rollback domain: Custody LockHoardAndCloseSource, Core Found-and-permit, Custody RealizeAndClose, Claims FoundingV5, Core Open LAST. Measured 1,184,132 at cd05331 (84.6% of the ceiling) and 1,278,747 at d9f79bb (91.3%) in ONE EVENING from other lanes' changes to Core, Claims and Trading, which is the growth W1f named as urgent and unowned. The pin is the higher of the two 2026-08-27 draws; the lower draw at 3b0c588 was 1,220,253. Remaining ceiling headroom from the pin is 121,253 CU, 8.7%, AND SHRINKING. The budget is 51,253 CU below the ceiling: when this transaction's measured value rises past 1,330,000 the budget can no longer be written at this tolerance and the evaluator refuses the file. That refusal is the point. This number's job is not to bless 1,278,747.

budgets.unenforced_reason: There is no measurement to budget. The RPC truncates the finalized log before the commit-last Open stage's own accounting line, so the only figure available for `Core Open plus the outer's five cross-request joins` is ARITHMETIC: whole minus 300 for the two ComputeBudget instructions minus the four measured stages. It came to 328,669 at d9f79bb and 322,681 at 3b0c588. A subtraction inherits every other row's noise and would red-row on all of it at once, so it is recorded here and not asserted. budgets.provenance: Derived, not measured; see unenforced_reason. Recorded so a reader does not conclude the Open stage was forgotten.

budgets.transaction: DCLTPCB1 refuses a reordered FundingState tail and rolls the transaction back
budgets.provenance: The hostile case W1e refused to count until run 5 supplied a discriminator. It matters that it stays BELOW the honest transaction it shadows: when the two were within 300 CU of each other the refusal was indistinguishable from an out-of-memory death at the same point. This budget does not check that relation — it is a ceiling on one number — but a red row here is the first sign that the two have converged again.

budgets.transaction: create canonical Found31 Market
budgets.provenance: Canonical Core Found31, the 31-account frame routed over a finalized ALT. This is the transaction that ALREADY died at the ceiling once: before c61376d it hashed Core's 1.0 MB ELF twice and exhausted 1,400,000 CU outright. budgets.transaction: Series Consume refuses a substituted Claims ProgramData
budgets.provenance: Highest of SEVEN runs, range 183,223-189,223, band 6,000. It was the quietest row in the fast lane at band 1,500 over the first six runs; the seventh, taken after the 2026-08-27 Custody frame change (`the callee must be ABSENT from the frame`), drew 189,223. 4,500 is exactly three bump-search iterations, so this lane did NOT distinguish noise from that change and does not claim to have. The re-pin is to the highest observed draw, which is what `measured` means here; the budget rose 4,500 and the row was green at the old budget with 15,500 to spare either way.

budgets.transaction: canonical Direct Profile14 Hot bundle
budgets.unenforced_reason: There is no green number to pin. The canonical Hot bundle does not pass at HEAD: the tail is over the 32,768-byte heap at phase 7 (WAVE.md, W2i lane), so `real_registry_executes_profile14_direct_hot_under_protocol_limit` in programs/dclutch-trading-sbf/program-test/tests/registry_hot_continuation.rs is not a green transaction whose CU could be budgeted. Its phase subtotals additionally require `--features hot-cu-profile`, which switches the ten `hot_cu_checkpoint!` sites from no-ops to log lines, so an ordinary run emits no phase data at all. Both files are W2i's live surface and this lane is read-only toward them.
